messages:
kyle-runtime: Quick sync: proposing we shift slot/lease ownership out of the coalescer into admission. Reason: reduce racy handoffs and make preemption deterministic.

kyle-runtime: Coalescer becomes a pure packer/optimizer; admission issues versioned leases that carry headroom and preempt weight.

omar-ml: Makes sense. How do we handle KV cache affinity during slot moves?

kyle-runtime: We'll publish lease_transfer events (slot, from, to, seq). Dest can prefetch KV ranges; source serves during short overlap.

jen-product: Product ask: can Dedicated customers get p95 guarantees from this?

kyle-runtime: Yes. Map SLA to reserved slot count + preemption weight in admission policy. Coalescer won't evict reserved slots.

Tina-sre: Where is lease state stored? Control plane authoritative with local caches + TTLs to avoid split-brain. Nodes continue on last-known leases if disconnected.

tina-sre: Need runbook for control-plane partition and forced revocation.

omar-ml: Also expose a kvcache_miss_cost metric so Optimize can recommend reservations.

ci-bot: CI: branch batcher-admission-proto passed unit tests, integration queued. :white_check_mark:

kyle-runtime: I'll draft an RFC with diagrams, failure modes, and a 1k-tenant sim. Reviewers for SRE/ML/product?

jen-product: I can review SLA wording.

Tina-sre: I'll handle observability and runbook drafts.

omar-ml: I'll validate KV warmup perf in the sim.

kyle-runtime: Thanks — posting RFC link when ready. :coffee:
